lines: Don't leave me near the Cold Ocean. That water bites hard enough without me facing it alone.
The Cold Ocean is no place to lose track of each other. One bad slip and I am done for.
I waited by the Cold Ocean trying to ignore how quickly that wind chills through me.
If you disappear beside a Cold Ocean, all I can think about is freezing before help returns.
The Cold Ocean does not give second chances. Please do not make me wait there alone again.
I kept looking at the water, wondering how fast it would take the warmth from me.
Next time we pass a Cold Ocean, stay where I can see you.
The wind off that water made every minute feel longer than it was.
I can handle cold. I cannot handle being forgotten in it.
Being left beside the Cold Ocean made me feel very small, and very far from safe.
Don't leave me by the Deep Cold Ocean. Cold water and deep water are both bad enough already.
The Deep Cold Ocean made every <wavy>wave</wavy> sound like a threat while I was waiting for you.
I was alone near the Deep Cold Ocean trying not to think about how little room I had for mistakes.
If you are going to lose me, do not do it beside a Deep Cold Ocean where everything feels fatal.
That water looked endless. Waiting beside it alone did not help.
The Deep Cold Ocean is the sort of place where even silence feels dangerous.
I kept thinking about what would happen if I slipped, and none of the answers were good.
Please do not leave me staring at deep cold water again.
The cold was bad. The depth made it worse.
I could not stop watching the waves. It felt like they were waiting for me to make one mistake.
Don't leave me near the Deep Frozen Ocean. Cold, depth, and ice are a terrible combination.
The Deep Frozen Ocean is no place to stand alone while the wind cuts through everything.
I waited by the Deep Frozen Ocean wondering whether the cold or the water would claim me first.
If you vanish beside a Deep Frozen Ocean, I am left with ice, depth, and no good options.
That place felt like it was built out of every bad decision at once.
The ice looked solid enough until I had to trust it alone.
I kept listening for cracks and hoping none of them were under me.
Please do not leave me where the ocean is frozen on top and endless underneath.
The Deep Frozen Ocean makes even standing still feel risky.
I was cold, exposed, and very aware that help was not nearby.
Don't leave me by the Frozen Ocean. Ice and freezing water are not mistakes I can afford.
The Frozen Ocean made every gust feel cruel once I was standing there alone.
I waited near the Frozen Ocean wondering whether the ice would hold if I had to move fast.
If you wander off beside a Frozen Ocean, I am left with cold, cracks, and worry.
The ice kept making sounds. I kept pretending I was not counting them.
A Frozen Ocean is pretty from a distance. Up close, alone, it is just dangerous.
I do not like waiting somewhere where the ground might stop being ground.
Next time, do not leave me beside freezing water with nowhere warm to go.
I was afraid to move and afraid to stay still. That is not a good place to leave someone.
The Frozen Ocean made me feel like one wrong step would be the whole story.
Don't leave me on the Frozen Peaks. One slip up there and the mountain <shake>finishes the story</shake>.
The Frozen Peaks are all wind, ice, and bad footing. I needed you back quickly.
I was alone on the Frozen Peaks trying not to let the cold or the height get into my head.
If you disappear on the Frozen Peaks, I am left freezing above a very long fall.
Every step up there felt like it wanted to become my last one.
The mountain was loud with wind and quiet with everything else. I hated it.
I kept my feet still because I did not trust the ground to forgive me.
Please do not leave me alone where the air is thin and the fall is not.
The Frozen Peaks are not a waiting room. They are a warning.
I was cold, stranded, and one bad patch of ice away from being gone.
Don't leave me by the Frozen River. Ice only looks patient until it breaks.
The Frozen River was too cold and too uncertain to be waiting beside alone.
I stood near the Frozen River trying not to trust the ice more than it deserved.
If you wander off at a Frozen River, I am left choosing between cold banks and colder water.
The river sounded alive under the ice. That did not comfort me.
I kept wondering how thick the ice was, which is not a thought I enjoy having alone.
Frozen water is still water. It just waits longer before it ruins you.
Please do not leave me beside a river that might open beneath my feet.
The banks were cold, the ice was worse, and you were nowhere nearby.
I did not know whether to stay on the edge or move away. Both felt like mistakes.
Don't leave me in the Grove. Snowy woods on a slope are still dangerous, no matter how calm they look.
The Grove was quiet in the worst way once I realized I was standing there by myself.
I waited in the Grove with snow underfoot and too many shadows between the trees.
If you vanish in a Grove, I am left cold, uphill, and listening for trouble.
The trees made it hard to see far, and that made every sound feel closer.
A Grove looks peaceful until you are alone and unsure which way you went.
I kept watching the gaps between the trees, expecting something to move.
Please do not leave me where the snow hides tracks and the woods hide everything else.
The Grove swallowed your footsteps faster than I liked.
I was cold, surrounded by trees, and very aware that I did not know where you were.
Don't leave me out here in the Ice Spikes. It's already so cold and dangerous as is.
The Ice Spikes are all freezing wind and sharp towers. I did not want to face that alone.
I was stuck in the Ice Spikes trying not to panic every time the wind howled through them.
If you disappear in the Ice Spikes, I am left shivering between blades of ice and bad luck.
Those spikes make the whole place feel like it wants you gone.
I kept turning around because every ice tower looked like something standing behind me.
The cold was bad enough, but the shape of that place made it worse.
Please do not leave me somewhere that looks like the ground grew teeth.
The Ice Spikes are not just cold. They feel hostile.
I waited there with frozen hands and no idea which direction was safest.
Don't leave me on the Jagged Peaks. The name alone should have warned you.
The Jagged Peaks are too steep and too cold to be abandoned on.
I waited on the Jagged Peaks trying not to think about how little room there was for a misstep.
If you vanish on the Jagged Peaks, I am left clinging to rock and hoping for your return.
Every edge up there looked sharp enough to punish a mistake.
The wind shoved harder than I liked, and the mountain did not care.
I had nowhere comfortable to stand and nowhere safe to fall.
Please do not leave me on a peak that already sounds like a <red><bold>threat</bold></red>.
The Jagged Peaks made every step feel like a negotiation.
I was balancing between cold stone, sharp drops, and a growing fear you were not coming back.
Don't leave me on the Snowy Beach. Cold wind off the water is miserable enough already.
A Snowy Beach is all freezing air, open ground, and too few places to hide.
I waited on the Snowy Beach trying not to let the cold make me careless.
If you vanish on a Snowy Beach, I am left shivering between surf and snow.
The waves kept coming in like they had somewhere better to be.
There was no shelter, no warmth, and no sign of you.
A beach should not feel that empty, but the snow managed it.
Please do not leave me where the cold comes from both the ground and the <aqua><wavy>water</wavy></aqua>.
The Snowy Beach made waiting feel exposed in every direction.
I kept watching the shoreline, hoping you would come back before the cold settled in.
Don't leave me in the Snowy Plains. Cold and open is a terrible combination.
The Snowy Plains gave me nowhere to hide and far too much wind to endure.
I stood in the Snowy Plains watching the horizon and wishing it had fewer dangers on it.
If you disappear in the Snowy Plains, I am left freezing in the open with no shelter nearby.
Everything was visible out there except you.
The plains made me feel exposed, like anything could see me coming from far away.
I kept looking across the snow and finding nothing useful.
Please do not leave me in a place where there is nowhere to hide from the cold.
The Snowy Plains turned waiting into standing still for the weather.
I was alone in the open, and the open did not feel kind.
Don't leave me on the Snowy Slopes. Ice and inclines are bad partners.
The Snowy Slopes are cold enough without adding the risk of sliding into trouble.
I waited on the Snowy Slopes trying to keep my footing and my nerves at the same time.
If you wander off on the Snowy Slopes, I am left freezing on a tilted problem.
Every step felt like it might turn into a slide.
I could not relax there. Even standing still felt like work.
The snow hid enough of the ground to make me distrust all of it.
Please do not leave me on a slope where one wrong move sends me somewhere worse.
The Snowy Slopes made waiting feel like balancing.
I was cold, uneasy, and trying very hard not to move the wrong way.
Don't leave me in the Snowy Taiga. Cold trees and deeper shadows are not comforting.
The Snowy Taiga was quiet in a way that made me expect the worst.
I waited in the Snowy Taiga listening to the wind in the pines and not much else.
If you disappear in a Snowy Taiga, I am left cold under dark branches with no help in sight.
The trees blocked the view but not the cold.
I kept hearing things in the branches and hoping they were only branches.
A Snowy Taiga does not feel empty. It feels like it is holding its breath.
Please do not leave me where the woods are dark and the snow makes every sound strange.
The pines made it hard to tell where anything was coming from.
I was cold, alone, and surrounded by enough trees to make every direction feel uncertain.
